_test_case_note: The concrete production reconciliation case, brought into version control. Pipeline e41a47ba (dataflow_group_id dfg_geneva_tariffs_recon) is deployed live in dev_flowx from another user's bundle and has no resources/*.yml in THIS repo, so it could not otherwise be replayed by the verification wave -- see enhancement_logs/v1.5.00_enhancement_log.md's known gaps. This spec flips its reconciliation flow to execution_mode 'pipeline' and sets publish_schema explicitly, because the DEFAULT publish_schema (the hosting pipeline's own schema, bronze_excalibur) is not where an operator would want geneva's reconciliation results published. The comparison's FAR SIDE (target_configs[0].table, {{catalog}}.bronze_excalibur.bronze_tariffelementband) is produced by a SEPARATE pipeline (1d44cca6, dataflow_group_id dfg_zerobus_tariffelementband_cdc) that is NOT part of this spec document -- genuinely external to this group's own graph, read once per update and materialized as this flow's L3 far-side node. target_configs[0].append_target_table ({{catalog}}.geneva_admin.landing_tariffelementband) is the raw landing/bus table the OTHER pipeline's zerobus ingestion consumes -- a real landing -> zerobus -> bronze -> recon -> landing correction loop spanning two dataflow groups. This validator (onboarding/spec_validator.py::_validate_reconciliation_pipeline_placement) sees only THIS document's own ingestion_flows, which contains no zerobus flow reading that locator, so it validates cleanly with neither a V-CYC-3 error nor a V-CYC-4 warning -- the documented, acknowledged limitation that true cross-SPEC awareness is out of reach for a single-document validate_spec() call (see docs/13's 'A CROSS-PIPELINE FEEDBACK LOOP IS INVISIBLE TO LAKEFLOW' section). PRE-EXISTING AND NOT FIXED BY THIS SPEC: the live dfg_zerobus_tariffelementband_cdc control-table row still carries the v1.4.0-removed 'normalize_column_names': true, so re-onboarding THAT group (not this one) will fail until it is migrated to column_normalization: {enabled: true}.

ingestion_flows.source_description: Geneva's own batch Auto Loader ingestion of its tariff-element-band extract -- the reconciliation flow's NEAR SIDE below. Because this is an in-graph target of THIS same dataflow group's pipeline, the reconciliation source reads this update's freshly written rows (V-CYC-1), strictly fresher than the standalone job-mode engine's one-task-later read of whatever the pipeline last committed.
